search_policy: Native-language and English discovery, followed to primary author/publisher/maintainer material for technical claims. Secondary pages and forums were discovery-only except identified author release posts. Some searches returned no relevant primary result; languages do not imply exclusive national origin.

unresolved_retrievals.reason: Search listing found; full open failed. Exactness, code and licensing unresolved; entry C26 not promoted.
Guessed file path returned404; no claim based on it. Public format/API used instead; raw IEEE edge qualification remains open.
Direct directory fetch failed; implementation presence supported by maintainer README source link/directory listing, not compiled or file-level code audit.
Old path redirects; current https://bellard.org/ts_zip/ opened and used.

parallel_review: Existing main implementation agent separately reviewed Wikipedia as taxonomy and Mahoney UIQ/other benchmark pages against actual source. No new subagents spawned by this audit.
first_release_policy: A paper date, code availability and first release date are separate. Unknown first release dates are not inferred from a crawler date, repository presence, or software copyright year.
